question: Which four initiate grades are enumerated in this classification of practitioners?
premises: The teacher is named as a grade.
The practitioner, son-disciple, and initiated-one are named.
The enumeration is marked as a complete set.
inference: Therefore the four initiate grades are the teacher, practitioner, son-disciple, and initiated-one.
plain_english: The teacher, the practitioner, and also the son-disciple and the initiated one—thus are they enumerated.
